# Purv Taparia — Personal Portfolio

> Purv Taparia is a student in Grade 5 at Chatrabhuj Narsee School, Mumbai, India. He is a 5× published author, International Rank 1 English Olympiad winner, coder, newsletter blogger, and Arduino-certified maker.

## About

Purv Taparia (born ~2016, Mumbai, India) is a prodigious student with achievements spanning academic Olympiads, creative writing, hardware engineering, and software development. He studies at Chatrabhuj Narsee School (cns.ac.in), Mumbai.

**Roles:** Student · Published Author · Developer · Newsletter Blogger · Roller Skater

**Location:** Mumbai, India

- **LiteWarden** — Chrome extension for local password management [Jan 2026]
- **Antigravity Usage Monitor** — Analytics dashboard for Google Antigravity (Next.js, TypeScript) [Jun 2026]
